primaryChecks.text: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
primaryChecks.nextContext: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.
